messages:
Sam (AE): Starting VeloxBridge migration thread. They want a clear compat story: header mapping, streaming parity, and a plan for token/billing deltas. Can we sync tomorrow? @Priya @Lena
Lena (Solutions Eng): Tomorrow works. Need their API spec + a short list of 25 high-priority prompts they care about. Also ask them for any custom session header names (they use vb-session).
Omar (VeloxBridge-Eng): We'll upload our OpenAPI subset and a prompt sample set by EOD. Important: we have `vb-session` affinity and `delta-mode: true` streaming that sends token fragments with "is_final" flags. UX depends on receiving partials.
Priya (SE): We support chunked streaming and can emulate is_final semantics in the facade. Key parity risks: tokenizer differences, trailing whitespace, and punctuation normalization.
Alex (SRE): For staging we'll provision 10.200.40.0/26 and a temporary mTLS cert. Please provide VeloxBridge egress IPs. Note: dedicated pool lead time ~18 business days after contract.
Jordan (PM): I'll draft a one-pager decision rubric: tolerance buckets for output variance (cosmetic, formatting, semantic), cost tradeoffs, and fallback routing rules (e.g., route to rwd-small for budget path).
Sam (AE): Pricing ask: VeloxBridge wants a 6-month committed burst pool + blended token rate during peak periods. They asked for firm answers on how reserved throughput billing interacts with token fallbacks.
Priya (SE): Billing clarity: reserved throughput billed monthly; tokens consumed by fallback models are charged at the model's rate. We'll model scenarios. Also suggest quantization on dedicated to reduce GPU cost for batch workloads.
SecurityBot: VeloxBridge requested SOC2, pen test results, and EU data residency proof. Posted security questionnaire link: https://redwood.internal/sec/q/veloxbridge-2026 :lock:
Omar (VeloxBridge-Eng): We need BYOK + KMS in EU for EU traffic. Also want audit logs kept for 365 days encrypted at rest.
Priya (SE): Private deploy supports BYOK and customer-managed KMS. Audit log retention configurable — will confirm retention tiers with Compliance.
Lena (Solutions Eng): For parity testing I'll stand up a tiny compat shim that translates VeloxBridge OpenAPI calls to our /v1/respond. Example header mapping:
```
vb-session -> X-Session-Id
delta-mode: true -> Accept: text/event-stream
vb-client-version -> X-Client-Version
```
We'll also add a pre-tokenize pass: normalize unicode, collapse multi-space, strip trailing newline.
Sam (AE): Can we get an initial parity report before the exec review next week? Need items: top 10 deltas, token delta % by prompt, and a recommended mitigation path per delta.
Priya (SE): Yes. Plan: run 25 prompts through the shim, compare outputs, categorize deltas. Deliverable: short parity report + suggested prompt rewrites and a tiny response-normalizer (regex-based) for workshop demo.
Jordan (PM): Timeline: samples in 48h -> parity pass in 72h -> workshop + exec deck in 7 days. Any enterprise blockers?
Omar (VeloxBridge-Eng): Two big ones: 1) We can't expose EU PII to US regions. 2) We need SLA for session affinity during scale spikes.
Alex (SRE): For affinity, we can route by X-Session-Id with cookie hashing; will document failover behavior (sticky within a 10s window, then route to fallback pool). For EU routing, we can pin traffic to eu-west region; need legal sign-off for DPA.
Lena (Solutions Eng): Quick smoke curl for VeloxBridge engineers to test shim:
```
curl -N -H "vb-session: 42" -H "delta-mode: true" \
  https://staging.redwood-infer.net/compat/veloxbridge/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize invoice"}'
```
This returns SSE-like chunks containing partials and a final chunk with is_final=true.
Priya (SE): Tokenization note: VeloxBridge uses a legacy byte-granular tokenizer; expect 5-12% token count discrepancy. We'll provide a canonical token-normalizer to align token accounting for billing reconciliation.
Sam (AE): Sales asks: draft a commercial term for a 6-month burst commit with a capped overage rate. Also put in an option for a 12-mo discounted reserved capacity.
Jordan (PM): I'll add commercial options to the deck. Also include fallback policies and expected latency/SLOs for hosted vs private.
SecurityBot: Reminder: attach SSO integration guide and list of required certifications. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/attachments/veloxbridge
Omar (VeloxBridge-Eng): Uploaded spec + sample prompts at https://veloxbridge.share/samples.zip. Security lead is nina@veloxbridge.com.
Priya (SE): Got the samples. Starting parity harness now. I'll post preliminary findings in this thread and prep the shim for tomorrow's workshop.
Sam (AE): Great. I'll send calendar invites for the workshop and a pre-read packet. Action items recap: VeloxBridge upload samples (done), Redwood to run parity + shim (Priya/Lena), SRE to prepare staging (Alex), commercial draft (Jordan), security docs (SecurityBot).
